_meta.note: /catalog, /landmarks, and /search require no key (RelayAccess.IsGroupPath excludes them by design) and carry no request-rate limit anywhere in Program.cs, unlike /report which has ProblemReports.IsRateLimited.

scenario.actor: anonymous, no X-Group-Key header sent or required
scenario.amplificationNote: /catalog/{mode}/{endpoint} proxies to json.tarkov.dev on a cache miss (CatalogMirror.cs), so a sustained flood against a cold cache pressures the upstream source as well as the relay process itself.

contrastEndpoint.control: ProblemReports.IsRateLimited caps this specific endpoint at 3 requests per room per hour
